versos.hebraico: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם חָלָ֥ה חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לָמ֑וּת וַיָּב֣וֹא אֵ֠לָיו יְשַׁעְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־אָמ֜וֹץ הַנָּבִ֗יא וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ צַ֣ו לְבֵיתֶ֔ךָ כִּ֛י מֵ֥ת אַתָּ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִֽחְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: In those days was Hezekiah sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “Thus says Yahweh, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”
controles.kjv: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.
controles.livre: Naqueles dias Ezequias ficou doente, perto de morrer. E veio até ele Isaías, filho de Amoz, e lhe disse: Assim diz o SENHOR: Põe em ordem a tua casa, porque morrerás, e não viverás.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּסֵּ֧ב חִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ פָּנָ֖יו אֶל־הַקִּ֑יר וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to Yahweh,
controles.kjv: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the Lord,
controles.livre: Então Ezequias virou o seu rosto para a parede, e orou ao SENHOR,

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר אָנָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ זְכָר־נָ֞א אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לְפָנֶ֗יךָ בֶּֽאֱמֶת֙ וּבְלֵ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם וְהַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכִ֥י גָדֽוֹל׃ס

controles.web: and said, “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Hezekiah wept bitterly.
controles.kjv: And said, Remember now, O Lord, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
controles.livre: E disse: Ó SENHOR, lembra-te, eu te peço, de que andei diante de ti com fidelidade e com coração íntegro, e fiz o que era agradável aos teus olhos! E Ezequias chorou com muito lamento.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־יְשַׁעְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Then Yahweh’s word came to Isaiah, saying,
controles.kjv: Then came the word of the Lord to Isaiah, saying,
controles.livre: Então veio a palavra do SENHOR a Isaías, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הָל֞וֹךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔יךָ שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֶ֔ךָ רָאִ֖יתִי אֶת־דִּמְעָתֶ֑ךָ הִנְנִי֙ יוֹסִ֣ף עַל־יָמֶ֔יךָ חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: “Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘Thus says Yahweh, the God of David your father, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
controles.kjv: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
controles.livre: Vai, e diz a Ezequias: Assim diz o SENHOR, o Deus de teu pai Davi: Eu ouvi tua oração, e vi tuas lágrimas. Eis que acrescento quinze anos aos teus dias de vida .

versos.hebraico: וּמִכַּ֤ף מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר֙ אַצִּ֣ילְךָ֔ וְאֵ֖ת הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וְגַנּוֹתִ֖י עַל־הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּֽאת׃

controles.web: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.
controles.kjv: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
controles.livre: E das mãos do rei da Assíria eu livrarei a ti, e a esta cidade; e defenderei esta cidade.

versos.hebraico: וְזֶה־לְּךָ֥ הָא֖וֹת מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃

controles.web: This shall be the sign to you from Yahweh, that Yahweh will do this thing that he has spoken.
controles.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the Lord, that the Lord will do this thing that he hath spoken;
controles.livre: E isto te será por sinal da parte do SENHOR, de que o SENHOR cumprirá esta palavra que falou:

versos.hebraico: הִנְנִ֣י מֵשִׁ֣יב אֶת־צֵ֣ל הַֽמַּעֲל֡וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָרְדָה֩ בְמַעֲל֨וֹת אָחָ֥ז בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ אֲחֹרַנִּ֖ית עֶ֣שֶׂר מַעֲל֑וֹת וַתָּ֤שָׁב הַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר מַעֲל֔וֹת בַּֽמַּעֲל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָרָֽדָה׃ס

controles.web: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps. So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.”’”
controles.kjv: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
controles.livre: Eis que voltarei voltar a sombra dos degraus nos quais o sol desceu na escadaria de Acaz; dez degraus atrás.Assim voltou o sol dez degraus, pelos degraus que já tinha descido.

versos.hebraico: מִכְתָּ֖ב לְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה בַּחֲלֹת֕וֹ וַיְחִ֖י מֵחָלְיֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered of his sickness.
controles.kjv: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
controles.livre: Escritura de Ezequias, rei de Judá, quando ficou doente, e se sarou de sua enfermidade:

versos.hebraico: אֲנִ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי בִּדְמִ֥י יָמַ֛י אֵלֵ֖כָה בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֣י שְׁא֑וֹל פֻּקַּ֖דְתִּי יֶ֥תֶר שְׁנוֹתָֽי׃

controles.web: I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol.  I am deprived of the residue of my years.”
controles.kjv: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
controles.livre: Disse eu: No melhor  de minha vida, irei às portas do mundo dos mortos; privado estou do resto dos meus anos.

versos.hebraico: אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ לֹא־אֶרְאֶ֣ה יָ֔הּ יָ֖הּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַחַיִּ֑ים לֹא־אַבִּ֥יט אָדָ֛ם ע֖וֹד עִם־י֥וֹשְׁבֵי חָֽדֶל׃

controles.web: I said, “I won’t see Yah, Yah in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
controles.kjv: I said, I shall not see the Lord, even the Lord, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
controles.livre: Eu disse: Não verei mais ao SENHOR, o SENHOR na terra dos viventes; não mais olharei aos homens com os que habitam o mundo.

versos.hebraico: דּוֹרִ֗י נִסַּ֧ע וְנִגְלָ֛ה מִנִּ֖י כְּאֹ֣הֶל רֹעִ֑י קִפַּ֨דְתִּי כָאֹרֵ֤ג חַיַּי֙ מִדַּלָּ֣ה יְבַצְּעֵ֔נִי מִיּ֥וֹם עַד־לַ֖יְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up, like a weaver, my life. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
controles.kjv: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
controles.livre: Minha morada foi removida e tirada de mim, como uma tenda de pastor; enrolei minha vida como um tecelão; ele me cortará fora do tear; desde o dia até a noite tu me acabarás.

versos.hebraico: שִׁוִּ֤יתִי עַד־בֹּ֨קֶר֙ כָּֽאֲרִ֔י כֵּ֥ן יְשַׁבֵּ֖ר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָ֑י מִיּ֥וֹם עַד־לַ֖יְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
controles.kjv: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
controles.livre: Fiquei esperando  até a manhã; como um leão ele quebrou todos os meus ossos; desde o dia até a noite tu me acabarás.

versos.hebraico: כְּס֤וּס עָגוּר֙ כֵּ֣ן אֲצַפְצֵ֔ף אֶהְגֶּ֖ה כַּיּוֹנָ֑ה דַּלּ֤וּ עֵינַי֙ לַמָּר֔וֹם אֲדֹנָ֖י עָֽשְׁקָה־לִּ֥י עָרְבֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security.”
controles.kjv: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O Lord, I am oppressed; undertake for me.
controles.livre: Como o grou, ou a andorinha, assim eu fazia barulho; e gemia como uma pomba; ao alto eu levantava meus olhos. Ó SENHOR, estou oprimido! Sê tu minha segurança!

versos.hebraico: מָֽה־אֲדַבֵּ֥ר וְאָֽמַר־לִ֖י וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑ה אֶדַּדֶּ֥ה כָל־שְׁנוֹתַ֖י עַל־מַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃

controles.web: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.
controles.kjv: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
controles.livre: Que direi? Tal como ele me falou, assim fez; passarei lentamente por todos os meus anos, por causa da amargura de minha alma.

versos.hebraico: אֲדֹנָ֖י עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יִֽחְי֑וּ וּלְכָל־בָּהֶן֙ חַיֵּ֣י רוּחִ֔י וְתַחֲלִימֵ֖נִי וְהַחֲיֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them: you restore me, and cause me to live.
controles.kjv: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
controles.livre: Ó Senhor, por estas coisas é que se vive, e em todas elas está a vida de meu espírito. Então cura-me, e deixa-me viver.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֥ה לְשָׁל֖וֹם מַר־לִ֣י מָ֑ר וְאַתָּ֞ה חָשַׁ֤קְתָּ נַפְשִׁי֙ מִשַּׁ֣חַת בְּלִ֔י כִּ֥י הִשְׁלַ֛כְתָּ אַחֲרֵ֥י גֵוְךָ֖ כָּל־חֲטָאָֽי׃

controles.web: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.
controles.kjv: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
controles.livre: Eis que para meu próprio bem tive grande amargura; tu, porém, com amor livraste minha alma da cova do perecimento; porque lançaste para trás de ti  todos os meus pecados.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י לֹ֥א שְׁא֛וֹל תּוֹדֶ֖ךָּ מָ֣וֶת יְהַלְלֶ֑ךָּ לֹֽא־יְשַׂבְּר֥וּ יֽוֹרְדֵי־ב֖וֹר אֶל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.
controles.kjv: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
controles.livre: Porque o mundo dos mortos não te louvará, nem a morte te glorificará; nem esperarão em tua fidelidade os que descem a cova.

versos.hebraico: חַ֥י חַ֛י ה֥וּא יוֹדֶ֖ךָ כָּמ֣וֹנִי הַיּ֑וֹם אָ֣ב לְבָנִ֔ים יוֹדִ֖יעַ אֶל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do this day. The father shall make known your truth to the children.
controles.kjv: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
controles.livre: O vivente, o vivente, esse é o que te louvará, tal como hoje eu faço; o pai ensinará aos filhos tua fidelidade.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֖ה לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי וּנְגִנוֹתַ֧י נְנַגֵּ֛ן כָּל־יְמֵ֥י חַיֵּ֖ינוּ עַל־בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Yahweh will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in Yahweh’s house.
controles.kjv: The Lord was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the Lord.
controles.livre: O SENHOR tem me salvado! Por isso tocaremos canções com instrumentos de cordas todos os dias de nossa vida na casa do SENHOR!

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְשַׁעְיָ֔הוּ יִשְׂא֖וּ דְּבֶ֣לֶת תְּאֵנִ֑ים וְיִמְרְח֥וּ עַֽל־הַשְּׁחִ֖ין וְיֶֽחִי׃

controles.web: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”
controles.kjv: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
controles.livre: Pois Isaías havia dito: Tomem uma pasta de figos, e passem-na sobre a inflamação, que ele sarará.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ מָ֣ה א֑וֹת כִּ֥י אֶעֱלֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to Yahweh’s house?”
controles.kjv: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the Lord?
controles.livre: Ezequias também tinha dito: Qual será o sinal de que subirei à casa do SENHOR?
